johns2003-hormuz-velocity-depths.source_citation: Johns,W.E.,Yao,F.,Olson,D.B.,Josey,S.A.,Grist,J.P.,and Smeed,D.A.(2003),Observations of seasonal exchange through the Straits of Hormuz and the inferred heat and freshwater budgets of the Persian Gulf,JGR Oceans108(C12),doi:10.1029/2003JC001881.
johns2003-hormuz-velocity-depths.source_locator: Section2.1 paragraph8 site depth;Section3.1.1 paragraph13 core depth;Section3.3 paragraph25 selected interface.
johns2003-hormuz-velocity-depths.manual_review_mode: Primary publisher fullHTML selected Abstract/Sections2/3 directly reviewed. No original HTML byte custody/hash,source image pixels,figure digitization or native velocity reconstruction.
johns2003-hormuz-velocity-depths.core_definition: Author-reported maximum-speed core band in averaged along-strait mooring velocity profiles,not full layer thickness or annual core-depth extrema.
johns2003-hormuz-velocity-depths.interface_definition: Author-selected transport-layer interface based on salinity gradients and maximum mean vertical shear,not a zero-velocity boundary.
johns2003-hormuz-velocity-depths.geographic_scope: Central deep channel in southern Strait of Hormuz at the mooring site. Prose coordinate26deg16.0minN,56deg05.0minE retained as text;Table1 coordinates differ slightly and are not numerically reconciled or mapped.
johns2003-hormuz-velocity-depths.temporal_scope: Mooring programme December1996-March1998. ADCP coverage December1996-December1997 has a multi-month gap and instrument failures;near-bottom current meter has gap/biofouling. Record and bimonthly means are not full annual extrema.
qualifications: Moorings in110mwater have upward ADCP15mabovebed and near-bottom currentmeter10mabovebed. The lowest near-bed layer is not directly resolved. Site bed depth is context,not an observed flow boundary.
Section3.3 chooses45m as the transport interface;Abstract broadly characterizes deepflow from40mtobottom. These are different definitions,not5muncertainty or seasonal interface change.
Reference layer uses chosen45m interface and local110m bed as an explicit transport-box geometry assumption. Subtraction is an OSW regional reference projection,not a new measured65mcurrentthickness.
Core60-70m is an averaged-profile band,not10mthickness,uncertainty or annualrange. No per-bimonthly numerical core changes digitized.
Near-surface outflow varies/reverses and may recirculate;not merged into deep outflow. Northern half ofstrait unsampled. Channel/equivalent widths not physical current width.

Source has an apparent year inconsistency in ADCP gap sentence. Do not infer corrected exact dates. Missing-month transports are interpolated in source;no interpolated currentdepth observations imported.
No unmeasured near-bed current reconstruction,whole-route longitudinalextent,lateralboundary join or physicalvolume.
johns2003-hormuz-velocity-depths.source_rights: Publisher free-access primary HTML. Only citation/link and15words across three short excerpts transcribed;no article/images redistributed.
